name: The Family
description: Aile is a story of Aslan who is the son of a large family, runs a nightclub. An extremely shrewd man. He is a dark and mysterious character. Psychologist Devin will enter the life of this difficult man and it becomes intense.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: The table is the only place that reminds the Soykans that they are 'family'. On that day, while a table was being set up for the whole family to gather, Aslan flew to Izmir to solve one of the 'dark' affairs to his uncle. The paths of psychologist Devin and Aslan cross in this journey. Devin is also going to Izmir to deal with a new trouble that his sister got into. It's very clear that they are people of different worlds. But it doesn't take long for them to discover their common 'wound'; their families. From the very first night, Aslan breaks a very important rule of the Soykan Constitution for Devin. This is enough for his mother, Hülya, to realize the great danger that is coming; Devin. Hülya's job, who has already shown many times that she can do everything to keep her son from leaving the family, will not be as easy as before. The encounter on the plane to Izmir will be only the beginning of the difficult road that our wounded heroes will take to establish their own families.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Devin's arrival at the dinner table is enough for Hulya to see her as a threat. Hülya decides to apply the tactic she knows best: keeping her friends close and her enemies closer... As a first step, she invites Devin to an event of the association she founded. Aslan's focus is to get his family out of illegal business. One of the most important steps of this operation; is to become a partner in the company of young business person Atilla Özyılmaz. Aysel, who has an accident, receives a helping hand from Cihan. Devin makes a decision after what happened at the event she attended with Hülya. But on his first night with Aslan, she succumbs to the attraction between them and is confronted with Aslan's unexpected move. Between the two, the ropes come to a breaking point. However, what happens at a surprise dinner table where they come together pushes Devin to make a big decision about her life. This decision will be the most important breaking point in Aslan and Devin's journeys.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: After Devin's proposal, Aslan and Devin decide to get to know each other better. A crisis on the farm sees Aslan with the potential in Devin; an unpleasant event the next night introduces Devin to the dark side of Aslan. Although the events cause Aslan and Devin to question their relationship, they cannot resist each other. Aslan, who learns that Ati has signed with İbo for the documentary project, sets out to disrupt the duo's partnership, which ignites a war. Under Hülya's secret guidance, Devin welcomes an unexpected visitor to his clinic: Cihan. The reason for this visit leaves Devin on the brink of a big decision. Hülya, who is aware of the marriage proposal, has a marriage contract drawn up for Aslan and Devin to protect her family. While this contract pits her against Aslan; on the other hand, it will push Aslan to take his own precautions for this marriage. However, this measure, which will destroy all of Devin's values, will put their relationship to a great test.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: With their relationship at a major stalemate, Aslan and Devin find themselves on the verge of separation. When they finally face the feelings they can't resist, reconciliation is inevitable; The couple takes the first steps for marriage. However, Devin also has a condition in return for the prepared marriage contract. The news of the sudden marriage resonates on the farm. Hülya uses her strongest trump card to prevent this wedding: Cihan, who persuaded Devin to therapy during the separation period with Aslan. Undoubtedly, Cihan will be one of the most important guests of this wedding. Ibo, on the other hand, tries to dominate the family by using the security gap in the farm as an excuse. Ati confronts Aslan. Now both Ibo and Ati are pin-pulled bombs for Aslan. And finally.. Drums and zurnas start playing in the Soykan farm! While Devin and Aslan are uniting their lives, an unexpected event at the wedding introduces Devin to the darkness of the Soykan family, of which she is now a part.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: With the gun attack on the farm, Devin needs the support of only one person as he goes through perhaps the most difficult days of her life: Aslan. But instead of Aslan, she finds herself with an army of bodyguards. Hülya, increases the pressure on her family members, especially Devin. Security measures are maximized at the farm until it is found who organized the attack. As she confronts the darkness of Soykan family, Devin, who begins to question the truths she believes about Aslan, knocks on Cihan's door to find an answer. While trying to get to know Aslan, she will also meet the darkness within himself. Aslan's focus is on finding the person who shot Eko. Anyone who might benefit from this attack is suspect to Aslan. Finally, the curtain falls… Aslan finds out who the attacker is. However, Devin asks Aslan to promise not to turn this into a vendetta. Hulya; While she is executing his plans to bring Aslan and Devin to the farm, will Aslan be able to keep his promise to Devin?

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: As Devin and Aslan begin to live on the farm, Hülya takes action to show that she has control over the family. She introduces Devin to Soykan's rules. Devin, who thinks that these rules violate her own freedom, confronts Hülya. Aslan plans an evening alone with Devin. The night they spend together in Volta, Devin brings Aslan face to face with a reality he has not been able to face until now, and it will change all the balances. After the fire, Ibo enters a new struggle with Aslan and makes a big move. He will confront Aslan with his greatest fear, the letter that Yusuf Soykan left to his son. However, Aslan isn't the only one shaken by his father's memories. Cihan knocks on Devin's door with the same feelings. While Devin is good for Cihan in this regard; he will harm Aslan. While a big fight between Devin and Hülya at a family dinner heralds a storm that will break out, Aslan witnesses this fight. Opposite Devin is a Aslan she hasn't met before. And now it's Devin's turn to confront.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: After the discussion at the dinner table, Aslan and Devin's marriage gets into a big stalemate. As Devin packs up his belongings and leaves the house, the couple comes to the point of divorce. In this process, Aslan, takes action to sell the casinos abroad. However, this situation brings him into conflict with his business partner, Serhat Koruzade. On the other hand, Hülya does not support Aslan's decision. Devin takes a break from going to the clinic during this period. Although Aslan and Devin meet weeks later due to an unexpected event, they do not take any steps to reconcile. On this night, however, their relationship will once again be put to the test, thanks to their feelings for each other. Serhat starts to follow Yağmur, who is the only eyewitness to the murder he committed in İzmir. On the other hand, Hülya, who reaches the evidence she wants about Yağmur's, will reveal the truth, and this will put the whole family, especially Aslan and Devin, in a new danger.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Aslan and Devin, before they can face the truth they learned; They find themselves in the hospital with a phone call. While Yağmur's treatment continues; Hülya, who learns that Serhat Koruzade is the one who did this to her, takes action to protect her family. At the end of a week, Aslan finds that it was Serhat who hurt Yağmur. Things have now gotten into an unbearable state. For Aslan, who grew up with the teaching that “ignoring oppression is a betrayal of the oppressed,” the punishment to be inflicted on Serhat is obvious. However, Devin and Hülya will stand against Aslan with their own truth. The events of an evening when they go out to restore Yağmur's morale cause a great confrontation between Devin and Yağmur; Eko, who is now sure that something is being hidden from her, pursues the truth. While Serhat's release puts him on Devin's scales of justice; A question from Aslan will allow Devin to make a decision that will change everyone's destiny. What will Devin decide?

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Serhat's death is the beginning of a great war for the Soykans. Serhat's lawyer, Suat, learns all the events and threatens to tell İlyas everything. While Aslan continues to cooperate with Cihan to solve this problem; The two brothers go after Suat. However, when they find it, they will encounter a surprise that will change all their plans. On the other hand, when Hülya learns that Serhat has died, she has to cooperate with İbo again to protect the family. Differences of opinion on this issue will bring Aslan and Hülya face to face. The struggle between Hülya and Devin is now much bigger. Devin questions whether she had a share in Serhat's death; İlyas Koruzade confronts the truth. On the other hand, the Soykans gather together for Kaya's circumcision wedding. However, with an unexpected guest coming to the wedding, Devin is now entering the Soykan circle, which she has not entered until this time; The Soykans will come face to face with the danger of İlyas Koruzade.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: After the sudden arrival of İlyas, the Soykans face a great danger; İlyas begins to investigate the cause of his son's sudden disappearance. It's only a matter of time before the truth comes out. Aslan tries to protect his family from İlyas; at the same time, he struggles not to become his father. Devin comes to the rescue of his mother, who was thrown out of her home by her father. Now homeless, Neşe starts living on the farm for a while; Devin will play the game according to the rules of Soykans and settle accounts with her father. At the family dinner, an argument over Leyla's decision to divorce causes great confrontations. Following the arrows of doubt in his son's death, İlyas finally finds a trace. On the other hand, Hülya, whose dominance over her family is shaken, gives Devin a great lesson; Aslan, who learns of Ati's dark intentions on Ceylan, will now darken his eyes. Will the soul of Yusuf Soykan, from whom he has been running away for years, will now take Aslan prisoner?

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Knowing that nothing will be the same from now on, Aslan shows Devin the last exit before the bridge to protect her from himself. Now, Devin will either leave this family without looking back or stay with Aslan and become a part of this family. Aslan, who confronted İlyas and tells him all the truth, started the war between the two families; İlyas vows to make the lives of the Soykans a living hell. After Ati's death, a police investigation begins. While the whole family, especially Devin, should have given false statements about the night of the incident; Devin continues to face the harsh realities of being Soykan. Will Devin stay with the family and give false testimony after all she's been through? Or will she burn the ships and take the whole family against her? In the face of the choice that İlyas forced her, Hülya takes a decision that will affect everyone's destiny; A major event on the anniversary of Yusuf Soykan's death will bring the Soykans face to face with death.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: After the explosion in the cemetery, Aysel and her baby are in a critical condition. Continuing his war from where he left off, İlyas corners Hülya to make a choice between her sons. While Hülya and İbo are looking for a new way to stop İlyas, Aslan sets up a plan to make his family pay the price. Moreover, Aslan will unite with Cihan in this plan. On the other hand, Ilyas's target is Devin. Forced to answer İlyas to protect her family, Hülya ultimately chooses between her sons. İlyas; He is now ready to deliver the final blow to end his war with the Soykans. He comes face to face with the name Hülya gave him. I wonder which son did Hülya named? Cihan? Aslan? Her own son? Or her adopted son?

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Planning to kill Aslan after Hülya's decision, İlyas encounters a big surprise. Just before the exchange of gunfire, İlyas gives Aslan a big clue about the adoption secret and the family's bloody past. Now Aslan has only one question on his mind. It's true what İlyas said? Learning that the man she loves has come face to face with death, Devin tells Aslan that she is pregnant. A phone call from Kıymet activates Hülya. The truth that emerges when Aslan learns who the adopted child is, deeply shakes Aslan and Hülya's relationship. On the other hand, Cihan also learns this fact. When everyone comes together for Yağmur and Eko's betrothal ceremony, all the secrets come to light one by one. Now it's Aslan and Cihan's turn to face off. The confrontation that will take place that night between the two brothers turns into a big showdown with the revealing of bloody secrets of the family. Now everyone is at a crossroads that will turn their lives upside down.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: After the Soykan table was destroyed, Aslan tried to gather his dispersed family together; He buys a marina to start a clean page in his life. Devin, on the other hand, is determined to end her marriage with Aslan after the price she paid. That's why he hires a divorce lawyer. A video leaked to the internet during the opening of the marina made the healing wounds bleed again; Everyone wonders the answer to the same question: Who leaked the video? After the leaked video, Devin finds himself in a seaside town far from everyone. However, he will not be able to escape from only one person: Aslan. Aslan tries to convince him so that they can become a family again and heal Devin's wounds. However, Devin will not easily forget the price he paid for this love. While we were having big showdowns at the donation night of Hülya Association; a big lie for years Learning that he lives inside, Cihan is now against the Soykans with all his might.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: While the whole process for the Soykans, who are taken into custody, proceeds as Aslan planned, Devin's move spins everything out of control. The family is now facing a great danger they never expected. While Aslan tries to find Tolga to regain control, Hülya sets a treacherous trap for Devin, whom she sees as the only one responsible for everything. Devin will either die or go to jail. Knowing that Tolga is the ticket to salvation for the Soykans in the investigation, Cihan and Serap take action to find Tolga. The developments that will take place at the moment when both sides trap Tolga in their nets will disrupt everyone's plans. Aslan, who is aware of the trap set for Devin, saves her from great danger at the last moment and takes Devin to a mountain house.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: As a new era begins for the Soykans with Devin's return to the farmhouse for the children, a huge fine is imposed on the Soykans in the investigation. Aslan seeks a partner in the marina to pay the fine, and the first person to knock on his door is his aunt Nedret Soykan, who lives in Adana. However, Nedret demands something from Hülya that will force her to accept this offer. Unfinished scores from the past will be reopened between the two women. While the need for Nedret drives Hülya mad with rage, Aslan begins to look for other ways to find the necessary money. On the other hand, he does his best to prove Leyla's innocence. There is another person who is desperate to save Leyla: Cihan.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: While Hülya experiences the pain of losing her home, which was her biggest castle in life, after the fire broke out in the farmhouse, Aslan does his best to save Leyla from prison. For this, Melek must live. On the other hand, Aslan, who received a negative response from Nedret about the marina partnership, is forced to engage in shady business again in order to pay the first installment of the large fine imposed on the Soykans. However, Devin wants to prevent Aslan from going down this irreversible path. Ilyas and Cihan, who learn that Aslan has returned to dirty work, see this as an opportunity. While Ilyas comes face to face with Aslan for the first time at the marina, Cihan, on the other hand, takes action for a new move that will end the Soykans. On the other hand, the fact that Cihan learns about Serap will bring the duo face to face.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: With Devin's persuasion of Nedret, a partner for the marina is found. However, Nedret's arrival in Istanbul will change all the balances within the family. As Hülya tries to maintain her dominance at home against her sworn enemy with whom she will now live, old memories will be reopened. On the other hand, Aslan tries to protect his dominance in the marina against his partner Bedri and goes after the traitor who undermined their business. Thinking that Ibo is now a big threat to them, Ilyas and Serap want to take him out of the game. While Serap devises the necessary plan, Cihan has someone new in mind to make an ally for them. He takes action for this. Confronting Devin for bringing Nedret, Hülya is determined to make Devin pay for her interference in her family through her own family.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Ibo, who comes close to death at the family table, starts to fight for his life in the hospital where he is hospitalized; the events of that night become a great trauma for Kaya and Zeyno. Devin takes action when the children want to leave the house. Aslan, whose only goal is to keep his family together, learns that Devin is a party to the custody case. This pits the two against each other; on the other hand, Aslan confronts Serap with the evidence he has. He uses this evidence as a trump card against Serap to free Leyla from prison. When Hülya learns that Devin has taken her grandchildren away from home, she devises a big plan. Nedret learns that Ilyas is trying to lure Bedri to his side and confronts Ilyas after years. Bedri, on the other hand, will confront Aslan, who will make a new business deal at the marina.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: As the Soykans begin to see the results of the news in the press, Aslan comes face to face with Devin and Nedret, who want to turn the custody case into a big fight. Hülya, whose statement was taken because of the news, started a two-pronged attack on Devin and Nedret to make them pay for this. Nedret, on the other hand, grows suspicions in Devin's mind. Aslan and Devin, who attend an important invitation for the future of the marina, declare a truce for one night. With this ceasefire, the fire of love flares up again as Aslan reminds Devin that they can fight hand in hand, not face to face. Waking up in a hotel room the next day, Aslan and Devin do not remember anything about last night. Taking action to save Serap, Ilyas devises a plan with Cihan. They ask for important help from Bedri, with whom they are in cooperation.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Devin, who finally surrenders to love after months, suddenly finds herself in the biggest test of her life. While Aslan is fighting for his life in the hospital, Devin decides to find the person or people who are trying to take the man she loves away from life. However, she will not walk this path alone. The greatest pain of their lives brings Hülya and Devin together. While the two women fight back to back for this cause, they go after the shooter who shot Aslan. While the note found in Ibo's room, whose treatment continues at home, increases Hülya's suspicion, Devin confronts Bedri at the marina. Realizing that Bedri is someone who can do anything for his ambitions further fuels Devin's suspicions.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: As a new era begins for Soykans, Aslan and Devin continue to live their love where they left off. After everything that happened, Devin makes a suggestion that she thinks will be good for both of them: starting couples therapy. Hülya takes action to regain her old power. Her first step will be to take back the land of the farmhouse. The results of Devin's tests on whether she will get pregnant or not come out. While Devin is in the hospital, Aslan learns about the cooperation of Bedri and Ilyas and devises a plan to make the two fight each other. Learning that they have a chance to become parents, Aslan and Devin make a new decision about their lives. When the day comes, they will raise their babies in a new home of their own. While Aslan takes action to find the house of his dreams, the duo shares this decision with the family.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: After Hülya's big gamble with her life to keep her son, Aslan sets a condition for Hülya's recovery in exchange for their continued stay at home: To start therapy. Devin, on the other hand, becomes a brick wall against Ergun, who tries to reach her. Ergun, who has lost everything after his hospitalization, starts threatening Hülya to save her from the situation she has fallen into. On the other hand, Nedret finds a new front to fight Hülya: SEVDEM Foundation. Aslan learns that Ilyas and Bedri's collaboration is still going on, and this time, he has a plan to cut Bedri's foot off from the marina for good. Devin will welcome a surprise guest at her clinic. Determined to go to couples therapy, Devin finds a new therapist.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: As Devin mourns the loss of her father, she receives the greatest support from Aslan. But when it is revealed that Ergun's death is suspected to be murder, a new struggle begins for Aslan and Devin. Aslan's investigation points to two people who may have caused Ergun's death: Hülya and Ergun's former partner Sermet. Shaken by the possibility of Hülya's involvement in what happened, Aslan finds himself in the most difficult test of his life. With this huge burden on his back, Aslan pursues the truth and tracks down Ergun's partner. Devin, on the other hand, continues her investigation about Hülya. Hülya starts working for the upcoming presidential election of the Sevdem Foundation and has a big rival in this election: Nedret.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Continuing couples therapy, Aslan and Devin decide to take a vacation alone. However, Seher's condition worsens as her illness progresses. After receiving this news, the two turn their vacation into a family vacation where they will also celebrate Seher's birthday. However, Seher has one last request - to see Cihan and Serap on this vacation. While Aslan is weary of this idea, Hülya's attitude is much harsher. Hülya's reaction escalates the suspicion that Serap knows something about her past. This suspicion spurs Aslan and Devin into action. Cihan decides to take Serap with him on a surprise family vacation. Serap, on the other hand, starts to work on her secret plan to settle past scores.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: The family is thrown into turmoil when long-hidden truths surface during a vacation and on its final night. Some members look to move forward while others plot revenge, leading to a confrontation at New Year's.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: While Devin survives the attack on New Year's Eve, Aslan faces the possibility of losing not only his love but also their baby. Faced with his biggest fear in life, Aslan now has only one goal: Ilyas and everyone involved in this incident will disappear until Devin opens her eyes. Cihan stands by Aslan's side. As the two brothers take action, Aslan will fearlessly defy death. As Hülya goes after the person who told Ilyas the location of the family on the night of the incident, Nedret does not leave her alone. Threatened with their families, Tugut, Iskoç, and Eko will be the main suspects. While Ilyas continues his struggle with Aslan, he also continues to carry out his own plan.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: With Devin's release from the hospital, the family breathes a sigh of relief, but a new test awaits Aslan and Devin. Because of the attack she suffered, Devin's pregnancy and delivery pose a life-threatening risk to both her and her baby. Aslan wants to be a father more than anything, but he cannot risk losing Devin. He thinks that they should terminate the pregnancy for Devin's health, while Devin is undecided. Seher makes a list of what she wants to do with her eyes on the world. Aslan takes action with Devin to fulfill his grandmother's wishes. A night the duo will spend together with Seher will be a turning point for their family. On the other hand, Hülya thinks that Kiymet might be a threat to them after Ilyas' death and visits her. Ferman starts to plan to kill Aslan as he promised.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: While Seher's loss shook everyone deeply; Aslan learns that Ferman is alive. Now, Aslan has begun to suspect that Babür's troubles in their lives are also the work of Ferman. Devin, who learns about Babür and Ferman, thinks that both threats should be eliminated. On the other hand, Aslan has a plan to keep Devin, who has a risky pregnancy, away from stress: birth preparation camp! Devin shares the information with Hülya and Nedret that Ferman is alive, despite all Aslan's warnings. While all family members are carrying out their own plans without knowing each other, Cihan manages to catch Ferman. Now he and Aslan need to make Ferman talk. However, their job is not easy at all. A surprise name will play a key role in the journey of making Ferman talk. And the big day finally arrives. While Bedri and Yağmur get married at the marina with a magnificent wedding, Ferman takes action to complete his unfinished business. Will the "Soykan Wedding Curse" occur once again?

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: After the attack they suffered after the wedding, all the Soykans, especially Aslan, are tested with great pain. While Aslan takes action to find Ferman; Hülya, wants to make Kıymet pay for what she did to her family. Devin will be the one who guides her for this purpose. On the other hand, a risky period begins in Devin's pregnancy. As the pregnancy progresses, the risk to life for Devin and her baby increases. As Devin faces the possibility of her child growing up without a mother; she enters into a preparation that she keeps as a secret from everyone. Aslan, on the other hand, takes his breath with him when he cannot reach Devin. However, he will encounter something he never expected. What is this big secret that Devin is keeping from everyone? The whole family gathers together. A big surprise that night will lead Aslan and Devin to their biggest fight. Will Aslan and Devin be able to establish their own family, for which they fought so hard, and end their story with a happy ending?
